text: doest thou well to be angry?: Or, art thou greatly angry?
gourd: Or, palmcrist. Heb. Kikajon | exceeding glad: Heb. rejoiced with great joy
Doest thou well to be angry: Or, art thou greatly angry? | I do well to be angry: Or, I am greatly angry
had pity: Or, spared | came up in a night: Heb. was the son of the night
